notes.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory Arrives in Less Than a Week!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Werewolf fans![/h2]

The wait is almost over! [b]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory is clawing its way to your screens in less than a week.[/b] Get ready to unleash your inner beast on [b]July 23, 2024[/b], when the game will be available across multiple platforms. Here's all you need to know!

[h3]🕒 Release time[/h3]
[b]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory will launch on July 23, 2024 at:[/b]
8:00 a.m. PT (US West)
11:00 a.m. ET (US East)
3:00 p.m. UTC
5:00 p.m. CEST (Europe)
11:00 p.m. CST (China)
1:00 a.m. (July 24) AEST (Australia)

[h3]💵 Pricing[/h3]
[b]You can get Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory for:[/b]
$14.99 / €13.99 (PC & consoles)
$9.99 / €9.99 (iOS)
[i]Check your local price on the release.[/i]

[h3]🎮 Platforms[/h3]
[b]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory will be available on:[/b]
PC
PlayStation
Xbox
Nintendo Switch
iOS

[h3]🔑 Key features[/h3]
[b]Complex protagonist[/b] – explore Samira's inner conflicts through a story-rich roleplaying game as she battles between despair and rage.
[b]Thrilling conspiracies[/b] – uncover the supernatural secrets of the werewolves’ world through two distinct story paths, each offering different challenges and consequences.
[b]Real-life settings[/b] – travel to popular landmarks and explore the wild landscapes of Poland and Afghanistan.
[b]Powers of a werewolf[/b] – intimidate, manipulate or, when all else fails, decimate all that stands in your way.
[b]Visual novel meets tabletop RPG[/b] – experience a blend of narrative-driven gameplay and tabletop RPG mechanics.
[b]Legendary World of Darkness lore[/b] – based on the new fifth edition corebook mechanics, the game emulates a classic role-playing experience.

Prepare to embrace your inner beast and make your mark on the World of Darkness. [b]Wishlist Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory on Steam now[/b], and get ready for an unforgettable experience starting July 23, 2024!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/

notes.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory claws its way to Steam on July 23, 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Werewolf fans![/h2]

[b]We're thrilled to reveal that Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory will be released on July 23, 2024![/b]
Get ready to dive into this captivating blend of fantasy thriller, visual novel, and tabletop RPG 🐺 
Step into the shoes of Samira, an Afghan werewolf and refugee, navigating a world where evil takes both human and supernatural forms. Uncover supernatural conspiracies, combat the deadly Wyrm, and explore the dark side of (in)human nature in the legendary World of Darkness universe.

Get ready to unleash the beast within! 🌕 And in the meantime, play the Demo to discover how Samira's story begin.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/

notes.title: Demo bug fixes are here!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Players,[/h2]

[b]Thank you for trying out the Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory Demo![/b]

We appreciate your feedback and cooperation. With your help, we have been able to address and fix the reported bugs, [b]particularly the issues with the Linux version[/b].

We encourage you to continue sending any bug reports or feedback to [i]support@differenttales.com[/i] if you encounter any issues. Your input is valuable to us as we strive to improve the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/

notes.title: Play the Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory Demo!
notes.content:
[h2]Experience the World of Darkness firsthand![/h2]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/]The Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory[/url] demo is live on Steam.[/b] Join Samira, a young Afghan werewolf, as she confronts both supernatural challenges and personal trials in her new life in Poland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031369/b196db3b2ac258a3a7456fdd5ea8fbbc768d6815.jpg[/img]
[h3]🐺 Inside the Demo:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Embark on Samira's Journey: Explore the choices that will define her path.
[*] Discover New Gameplay: Delve into a mix of visual novel and tabletop RPG mechanics, inspired by the latest Werewolf edition.
[/list]
[h3]🔑 Key Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adventure in Warsaw: Fight the forces of the Wyrm and decide Samira’s fate—will she overcome despair or give in to rage?
[*] Open to All: No prior knowledge needed, perfect for both newcomers and long-time fans.
[/list]
[h3]🌑 Stay Informed:[/h3]
Don't forget to add 'Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory' to your [b]wishlist[/b] for updates as we approach the full game release in Q3 2024.

Are you ready to uncover the truth? Start your adventure now by [b]playing the demo[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/
